A CORRECTION, NOT A NEW ADJUDICATION. bmdb 1554 hostap -rdynamic re-pass, batch 6 (src/crypto/sha384.c .. src/eap_peer/eap_tls_common.c). Stacked on correction-rdynamic-1554-hostap-b05.

RULING. aurora-lint ADR-0011 6b28c8d7 (Brandon, 2026-09-25): wpa_supplicant/Makefile:1004-1006 links with -ldl -rdynamic under CONFIG_DYNAMIC_EAP_METHODS, a compilable configuration (ADR-0010), so every non-static function linked into wpa_supplicant has an open caller set and in-tree call sites prove nothing about its parameters. Also applied: a prior dereference is not a check (d9cb04d0); &p->field with p unproven is a violation site; a (pointer, length) pairing is a contract, not proof.

SCOPE. FP rows whose reason rested on callers, in non-static functions of files wpa_supplicant links under some configuration (the union of its Makefile OBJS under every ifdef). This batch covers 121 such rows. Held back and NOT changed here: 17 whose key realworld run 274 no longer emits (pending a ruling on non-emitted keys), 0 inside an #ifdef HOSTAPD / hostapd-only CONFIG_* arm that the wpa_supplicant build cannot compile, 1 uncertain.

METHOD. One read-only agent read every row at source at the pinned commit, judging the value the run-274 message names, and decided whether any basis inside the function or its callees holds (a dominating test, a NULL-tolerant callee, a language guarantee, a local value's own flow, or the site not being a violation site). A fresh-context refuter re-read a sample (36 rows: every emitted FP keep or non-high call plus 30 random TP flips; 36/36 upheld. One flip (tls_internal.c:298) was held back: its only dereference is under CONFIG_TLS_INTERNAL_SERVER, which the wpa_supplicant build never defines. The tls_openssl.c:1383 FP rests on the file-static tls_global/tls_openssl_ref_count invariant (count >= 1 implies tls_global non-NULL, on every call order).).

RESULT. 101 FP -> TP here (API00-C 93, EXP34-C 4, ARR30-C 2, ARR00-C 1, INT16-C 1): the only basis was the caller set. 2 stay FP with the reason restated to its local basis (d 1, a 1).

Mechanics: in-place edits keep each key; each original batch takes a row_count decrement and a superseded_rows record. Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision claim is made here.
